title: bulbs don't last
text: bulbs don't last. I have a Whirlpool microwave  that has a halogen light bulb that lasted three weeks then went out.  So I ordered 2 of these bulbs.  Each burnt out within three weeks, I ordered a box of 5 led G9 7 watt bulbs by Enutek these bulbs did not fit but being led I just used a pair of pliers and snapped the base off and there are wires to the bulb that let me put the base in the socket and the light bulb hung down .  When putting the glass back up I let the bulb just sit on the glass  The light is twice as bright and white light.  I wish I had bought the 11 watt instead but still the light is better and it has been 2 months and still works.  I will never use halogen bulbs again.
